docs.description: Composed page selector — prev nav + page items (+ ellipsis gaps) + next nav. Use on paginated lists, tables, and search results where the total page count is known and random access matters. For linear step-through (wizards, detail pages) use Page Navigator. Collapse to a bare prev/next pair only when the collection size is unknown.
